raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 arrived with lowercase status values ('posted'/'reversed') and '$'-prefixed amounts. The exact-match filter status = 'POSTED' dropped every batch 12 row. Matching status case-insensitively and stripping '$' from amount recovers the 323 posted rows, and the lowercase reversed rows stay excluded as in other batches.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
